audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers read Akshan/Skill/Olaf/Olaf/Akshan/Olaf/Olaf while the packet levelChart reads Olaf/Akshan/Akshan/Skill/Skill/Akshan/Olaf — and the packet order is the one the whys[] describe, row for row.
audit.why: whys[0] 'Your Q-slow... beats his level-1 poke' is an Olaf row marked Akshan; whys[1] 'he chunks you' and whys[2] 'without Ragnarok you can't punish his disengage yet' are Akshan rows marked Skill/Olaf; whys[3] 'Pure skill matchup' and whys[4] 'Even window' are Skill rows; whys[5] 'his first lethality item lets him poke you down' is an Akshan row marked Olaf. Six of seven rows disagreed with their own text.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Olaf, Akshan, Akshan, Skill, Skill, Akshan, Olaf in BOTH layers as one atomic group, with ratings re-scaled to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was written as Ragnarok breaking Akshan's crowd control. It also framed his ult as a snare threat.
audit.why: Ragnarok is 100/90/80s: passive armour and MR, active immunity to disables while attacking. Against a champion with no disables the immunity does nothing — the resists and the uninterrupted chase are the actual value. His spike is the first lethality item, matching the packet's Akshan row at that stage.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated on resists and the run-down; the first-item stage handed to Akshan.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED CC. spikes[2], whys[4], mid, late, wants.you[2] and report[9] all reference 'his Q snare' / 'his snare cooldown'. Akshan has no snare and no hard CC anywhere in his kit.
audit.why: Riot text: Q Avengerang is a boomerang dealing damage out and back; W Going Rogue is camouflage and Scoundrel marking; E Heroic Swing is a grapple-and-swing; R Comeuppance stores bullets and fires missing-health damage. No slow, root or stun in any slot. The real cooldown to track is Heroic Swing at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s.
audit.corrected: Every snare reference removed; Heroic Swing named with its real cooldown as the tracked ability, and Comeuppance described as a 2500-range missing-health burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] says 'W-omnivamp'. Olaf's W is Tough It Out — attack speed plus a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s. His lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P), scaling with missing health.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf W: 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.' The mirror audit corrected the same two errors from Akshan's side.
audit.corrected: Named as the shield; Reckless Swing named for the true damage.

edits.before: Ragnarok deletes CC — once you press R, nothing he has stops the run-down. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Akshan has no CC, so Ragnarok is resists plus an uninterrupted run-down. Comeuppance still burns you from 2500 range — close the gap, never trade at it.

edits.before: Sundered Sky is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Swing's cooldown.
edits.after: His first lethality item out-paces you — poke wins until you get on him. Fight only on Heroic Swing's 18s.

edits.before: Ragnarok ignores his Q snare and lets you all-in through his W camouflage poke for the kill.
edits.after: Akshan has no CC for Ragnarok to ignore — its value at 6 is resists plus the uninterrupted run-down.

edits.before: Even window — your R answers his snare but he can still grapple out before you fully commit.
edits.after: Even window — Ragnarok's resists let you commit, but Heroic Swing still swings him out of it.

edits.before: Bait his E grapple toward a wall, then E-true-damage and W-omnivamp the trade once he's stuck
edits.after: Bait his 18s E grapple out, then Reckless Swing him and shield the answer with Tough It Out

edits.before: Hold Ragnarok for his Q snare and all-in level 6 before his lethality items come online
edits.after: Save Ragnarok for the run-down and all-in at 6 before his lethality items come online

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a coinflip — he's getting Q+W poke rhythm and lethality online, and if you whiff Q he chunks you for free between your cooldowns. At 6 your Ragnarok is the equalizer: it makes you immune to his Q snare so he can't peel your all-in, and the move speed toward him closes his kite. Use it the moment he's in lane without E-swing terrain. Don't ult into nothing — bait his snare or his grapple first, then commit.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a coinflip — his Avengerang rhythm and lethality come online, and if you whiff Q he chunks you for free between your cooldowns. At 6 Ragnarok is the equalizer, but not by breaking CC: Akshan has none. It is the resists and the run-down nothing interrupts, so land Undertow at his feet and pick the axe up for the reset. Use it while he stands with no terrain behind him. Don't ult into nothing — bait the 18s grapple first.

edits.before: Once his lethality build comes together he'd love to kite-poke you from range and roam with camouflage, but this lane stays even into the late game — your true damage still ignores his squishy build and Ragnarok still catches him mid-fight. Your job is to convert: take plates and dives on his snare cooldown rather than letting it drag into a poke war where his Q+passive whittle you. Don't facecheck his camouflage near objectives.
edits.after: Once his lethality build comes together he'd love to kite-poke you from range and roam with camouflage, but this lane stays even into the late game — Reckless Swing's true damage still ignores his squishy build and Ragnarok still catches him mid-fight. Your job is to convert: take plates and dives while Heroic Swing's 18s is down rather than letting it drag into a poke war where his Q and Dirty Fighting shield whittle you. Don't facecheck his camouflage near objectives.

notes: packet.defects already flagged that this entry never names an Akshan ability; every slot is now named at least once in the edited strings. Going Rogue (W) is camouflage, not invisibility, and its cooldown drops to 2s at rank 5 with 0 mana — a control ward or sweeper in the side brush is the real answer, but I left that out rather than invent a line to hold it. Olaf's kit file flags Undertow (Q) as 'grounding'; Riot's description says armour shred and slow only, so no grounding claim was made.
